## claude.ai Image Generator
Generates and edits images with an Azure AI Foundry deployment of gpt-image-2. Use generate_image for new images and edit_image to modify one that generate_image already produced.

Every result leads with the generated image as inline image content at full resolution, annotated for the user at priority 1.0. Show that image to the user directly — it is the answer, and it is already attached, so there is nothing to fetch. Download links follow at priority 0.2 as a fallback for saving the original file; do not make the user click one just to see the picture.
